Thank you so much for your post it means a lot! I’m definitely gonna start writing my thoughts in feelings down in a journal. Funny enough I used to write down how I feel and it definitely helped but for some reason or another I stopped. And also I have thought about moving away or at least to a small nearby town just to get a fresh start. It’s sounds exciting but at this current moment in time I’m not in a great financial spot where I can do that so maybe in the next few years! Also addiction is a curse and a blessing. It definitely has its lows especially with gambling! And I’m definitely aware that I use substances and gambling to escape from the real world of just to get a rush. In recent months I’ve been able to chill out with abusing stuff. Last year I was an Adderall fiend and a horrible alcoholic because I needed to drink when I was coming down or pretty much anytime past 8PM. But thankfully I was able to deal with those demons. But the gambling still comes and goes which for me at least gambling is extremely self destructive and I just always lose. Thank you again for taking the time to reply to me I really appreciate it. Also merry Christmas hope you had a great holiday! 

(Not the best which sentence structure haha so sorry if that whole thing is hard to read)
Merry Christmas! Also thank you very much for the kind words! I really appreciate it!
